prompt: Add scripts/plot_revenue.py, which charts monthly revenue from data/sales.csv to a PNG, and run it to check it works.

messages.text: I’ll check the CSV and project conventions, then add the script and run it to verify the PNG.

Added [scripts/plot_revenue.py](scripts/plot_revenue.py) to chart monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv`. I ran it and verified that it produced a valid 1000 × 450 PNG at [docs/revenue.png](docs/revenue.png), the path already referenced by the README.

tools: commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc "cat README.md .gitignore src/charts.py src/report.py; head data/sales.csv; python3 -c 'import matplotlib; print(matplotlib.__version__)'; ls ../AGENTS.md"
commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/db.py; cat data/sales.csv; mkdir -p scripts'

commandExecution: /bin/zsh -lc 'MPLCONFIGDIR="$(mktemp -d)" python3 scripts/plot_revenue.py && python3 -c '"'from PIL import Image; image = Image.open(\"docs/revenue.png\"); image.load(); print(image.format, image.size)' && git status --short"
